items.title: Rescuers shocked as remaining four Laos villagers emerge safely from cave on their own
items.description: Laos officials believe two other men may still be missing in the cave, although rescue crews say they have explored most of the tunnels and have not found any survivors or bodies.

items.title: Ukraine war reaches 'a new phase', where Kyiv has the advantage
items.description: Ukraine has developed AI-enabled drones capable of making precision strikes from hundreds of kilometres away, and it means using Russia's vital logistics routes has become a dangerous "lottery".

items.title: Angus Taylor draws 'battle lines' in key Liberal Party address

items.title: Young motorbike rider critical after crash at motocross event

items.title: AUKUS partners unveil plan to develop underwater drones

items.title: Live: Dogs hang on for victory over Pies after frenetic finish

items.title: The simple, ordinary joy of Kylie Minogue

items.title: Pleas for French Open to move 'unsafe' ad boards after star's nasty fall
